Sibuna v0.3.4 adds upstream Linux packages alongside the Linux, macOS and Windows
binary archives. Request inspection, console behavior and storage schema are
unchanged from v0.3.3. The embedded console source link now names v0.3.4.
The build-only source-map-js dependency is updated to 1.2.2 for GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q;
regenerated runtime CSS is byte-identical. This library is not shipped in the daemon.

Downloads:
- Linux x86-64 and ARM64: static musl binary archives, Debian .deb and RPM .rpm.
- Arch Linux x86-64: sibuna-bin .pkg.tar.zst, installed with pacman -U.
- macOS Apple Silicon and Intel: unsigned CLI archives; macOS 15 or later.
- Windows x86-64: native sibuna.exe archive; Windows 10 / Server 2019 or later.
- Corresponding-source bundle with verified SQLite inputs for offline builds.
- Source-built Homebrew formula (sibuna.rb); no cask. Tap/core acceptance is separate.
- Helm chart 0.3.4 and public image ghcr.io/insanai/sibuna:0.3.4 for amd64/arm64.

The Debian, RPM and Arch packages wrap the qualified Linux executable. They install
an optional systemd unit but do not enable or start it. Configure the IP-literal
origin in /etc/sibuna/service.env before explicitly starting the service. The
proxy defaults to 127.0.0.1:8080. Console setup remains an operator decision.
Installation/removal retains configuration, private admission seed, data and
service account. Upgrades require an explicit restart after backup and review.

These are unsigned upstream packages, not admission into Debian, Fedora or Arch.
Verify SHA256SUMS before installation. Signed APT/DNF/pacman repositories, AUR
submission, Homebrew core, Guix and BSD ports have separate gates. FreeBSD/OpenBSD
packages are not included until their native qualification passes.

Qualification required before publication:
- All five native binary builds and their existing executable/CRS checks must pass.
- Debian/Fedora/Arch installation, reinstall and removal preserve private seed/config.
- The systemd service starts/restarts and stops on removal on disposable CI.
- The Homebrew source formula builds and passes persistent startup/restart tests.
- The minimal non-root/read-only container and Restricted Kubernetes installation,
  Recreate upgrade and retained PVC/Secret checks pass before publication.
- IMAGE-DIGEST.txt records the anonymously accessible multi-platform image digest.
  The image includes CA certificates and identity data, with no shell/package utilities.

Upgrade:
- Console schema remains 46. No database migration is added in this release.
- Retain admission seed, console key and persistent state; back up before upgrade.
- Upgrading from before v0.3.2 requires upgrading all cluster nodes. Incompatible
  older binaries cannot use schema 46. Package/Helm rollback does not undo migrations.
- No measured request subsystem changed. Benchmarks remain tied to their recorded
  commits; the SID 0007 console performance exception remains.

Archives/packages include license texts, notices, security guidance and source
provenance. The engine is LGPL-3.0; the console and combined binary are AGPL-3.0.
Third-party materials retain their licenses. CRS rules are Apache-2.0, downloaded
and verified at runtime rather than bundled. Report suspected vulnerabilities
privately through the repository's GitHub security reporting page.

Documentation: https://insanai.github.io/sibuna/
